title: Cases: image plus question, Italian and English
goal: Regression and holdout cases cover the capabilities
acceptance: Owner decision 2026-11-26 in chat (relayed by the coordinator): "undo the F-143 dependency, park F-142 with its possible uses, and open the Gauntlet pack record"; Italian is required (the owner uses NERV in Italian).

Cases give an image and a question, each with an Italian and an English form: counting, colour, reading printed text (OCR), a yes/no checklist about the image, a chart value as json-match; regression and holdout splits with distinct fixture hashes
Expected answers are never sent to the model; holdout images are not reused in regression
privacy: Neutral invented data only; fixture images are drawn by code or openly licensed (licence recorded), never generated by a model; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
validation: npm run check:fast; final applicable CI
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed. Not a measurement.
